source = '''def transform(grid):
    h, w = len(grid), len(grid[0])
    marked = [[False] * w for _ in range(h)]
    for r, row in enumerate(grid):
        cols = [c for c, value in enumerate(row) if value == 9]
        if len(cols) >= 2:
            for c in range(cols[0] + 1, cols[-1]):
                marked[r][c] = True
    for c in range(w):
        rows = [r for r in range(h) if grid[r][c] == 9]
        if len(rows) >= 2:
            for r in range(rows[0] + 1, rows[-1]):
                marked[r][c] = True
    return [[3 if marked[r][c] and grid[r][c] == 1 else grid[r][c]
             for c in range(w)] for r in range(h)]
'''
